title: Sandustry Price: Early Access Cost, Demo & Where to Buy
description: Sandustry is a paid Early Access factory game from Hooded Horse with Steam regional pricing. A free demo is available, and sales can lower the price.
h1: Sandustry Price: How Much Does the Game Cost?

paragraphs: The definitive way to check the current Sandustry price is the game's Steam store page, which shows the cost in your local currency using Steam's regional pricing. Sandustry is a paid Early Access title published by Hooded Horse; there is no free version of the full game.
This article deliberately avoids quoting a single dollar figure, because the live price changes over time and varies by region. Any number printed here could be out of date within days.

sections.h2: Free Demo: Try Before You Buy
paragraphs: If you want to experience Sandustry before paying anything, the Sandustry Demo is free on Steam. It gives a first look at the early factory-building loop so you can judge whether the full game is worth the price.
Demo content and availability can change as the game updates, so check the demo page on this site or the official Steam demo listing for the current state.
Steam converts the base price into local currencies, so what you pay may differ from the US price depending on your region. Your personal store page is the only reliable source for your exact cost.
Like most Steam titles, Sandustry may be discounted during Steam seasonal sales or publisher events. When a discount is active, the store page shows both the standard and sale price.
Sandustry is in Early Access, and Hooded Horse has not published a final 1.0 price plan. As with many Early Access games, the price may change when the full version launches.
Treat the current Early Access price as subject to change, and see the early-access page on this site for the latest status of the game's development.
Steam is the only officially supported storefront for Sandustry at this time. The publisher, Hooded Horse, links to the Steam listing from its official channels.
Be cautious with third-party key resellers: keys bought outside Steam can be revoked or region-locked, and buying directly on Steam supports the developers.

note: No flat price is quoted here because Steam prices change over time and by region; treat any figure you see elsewhere as potentially stale and confirm the live price on the store page.
